title: Resources
content:
Use this page as a reading list for the example project. Each item focuses on a different part of turning a Blogger template into a maintainable static site.

Template structure

  • Keep sections and widgets in the layout editor.
  • Inspect generated HTML to see how includes are expanded.
  • Use validation messages to find malformed markup early.

Content workflow

  • Write posts and pages as JSON files.
  • Use the dashboard preview to test changes before publishing.
  • Rebuild to generate dated post routes and short page routes.

Design checks

Review the home page, a post, a label archive, search results and this page before calling a template finished. They exercise different data contexts and reveal different layout problems.
